messages:
maria_infra: Onboarding a new AP-SOUTHWEST edge account (org=aurora). Need quota bumps for p5/p4d/g5 + ENIs and an EIP pool. Pilot next Wed — can someone kick off the requests? :pray:

kai_ops: What's the AWS account ID and exact regions? We'll need expected capacity to justify the p5s and extra ENIs.

maria_infra: Account: 987654321098. Regions: ap-southwest-1, ap-southeast-3. Desired initial quotas:
```
p5.48xlarge: 8
p4d.24xlarge: 4
g5.48xlarge: 16
ENIs: 120
EIPs: 20
```
Justification: mixed training trace replays + inference fleet for APAC customers. Expected peak concurrent nodes ~60 across regions, burst to 90 during pilot.

lee_cloud: Subnet sizing check — recommend VPC /22 (or two /23s) so pods/instances don't exhaust secondary IPs. NATGW EIP capacity looks like the likely blocker for egress. Suggest reserving an org-level EIP pool.

julia_networks: Also confirm ENIs per instance: p5/p4d typically attach multiple ENIs. If we assume avg 2 ENIs per node that's ~180 ENIs at peak. IPv6 fallback could mitigate EIP pressure if AWS acct allows it. :thinking_face:

quota-bot: Reminder: use the AWS Service Quotas console and attach architecture justification. Template: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home (automated)

kai_ops: Filed support case 1234567890 with above numbers and business justification; requested expedited review citing production pilot next Wed. AWS case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890

maria_infra: Thanks — I'll add the runbook items (VPC /22, reserved EIP pool, ENI assumptions). @lee_cloud please confirm EIP reservations when you have them.

lee_cloud: Will reserve 24 EIPs per region for now (can increase later). Updating support case with reservation note. ETA ~2h.

deploy-bot: Scheduled capacity smoke test on ap-southwest-1 for 2025-04-02T09:00Z pending quota approval.

maria_infra: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will hold pilot schedules until AWS confirms. :thumbsup:
